tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your friend Jordan are planning a trip to Europe during your university's summer break. You have done some research and found some interesting destinations and activities that you would like to include in your itinerary. You want to share your ideas with Jordan and get their opinion. Write an email to Jordan.
bullets: Describe the destinations you have researched.
Explain why you think these destinations would be enjoyable.
Ask for their opinion on the suggested itinerary and any additional ideas they might have.
tasks.subject: Summer trip itinerary ideas
